answer: In an agent economy trading quartz, every identity crossing the marketplace bridge must lock 100 credits in a public escrow for 30 days before it can bid or vote. The ledger prevents the same credits from backing multiple identities, so an attacker cannot turn a whisper of capital into thousands of influential accounts: 1,000 active identities require 100,000 credits immobilized for a month, imposing financing costs even if no fraud is detected.
